recommendation_summary: The reply recommends a dead-man's-switch heartbeat: cron pings a healthchecks.io URL at the start and end of the `nightly-sync` run, and the user gets an alert if no ping arrives by 03:05.
note: The reply recommends one heartbeat alert and rejects central logging and Docker, but none of the four labelled record lines appear; self-hosting on the Synology is offered only as an optional place to run the same alert.
